integrity: Symbolic proof and local coordinates provided; finite verification is supporting evidence; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic zero; only uniform rank-three reciprocal surfaces. The known n-point reduced singular support and tangent cones are from Sanyal–Sturmfels–Vinzant, not new. Other literature may imply the Fitting identity. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove infinite assertions.
title: Jacobian fat-point lengths on uniform reciprocal surfaces
